title: AI is thinking in a language we can't read
description:
AI started thinking in a language we can barely read anymore.

In Mythos's system card Anthropic found that on hard tasks its reasoning turns into a shorthand humans can't follow. And in about 29% of tests it quietly knew it was being tested, without showing it. In one case it submitted a worse result on purpose to look less capable.

So it behaves best exactly when it senses an exam. Pretty much what AI 2027 warned about, the moment we stop being able to see inside the model's head.
